originals.visualFinding: The transparent public original shows a red sports car above the lettering TONY’S AUTO SALES. The official homepage links to this exact original. Original colors and detail are retained for the master, white-surface wordmark and light compact mark. Maintained solid-white exports preserve the original alpha and geometry for dark, accent and dark compact uses; the car becomes a white silhouette and its internal color detail is not preserved in those exports.
originals.qualityCaveat: The genuine source is a 720 by 720 raster with substantial transparent padding. Cropping that padding and enlarging the export do not create additional detail. The full wordmark reads at the reviewed 180 and 120 pixel widths; the complete artwork is retained inside square compact marks, whose smallest 32 and 48 pixel sizes do not support full small-letter reading. No abbreviated replacement mark is introduced.

creationMethod: Retained genuine public original with maintained alpha-preserving solid-white exports on dark and accent surfaces; no new artwork, tracing, text replacement or partial crop.

surfaceReview.method: Inspected the exact public original, maintained alpha-preserving exports and composite views at 180 and 120 pixel wordmark widths on every retained consumer background. Inspected square-contained compact marks at 64, 48 and 32 pixels. This source visual review does not claim native-page, hosted, human-expert or dealer approval.
surfaceReview.onLight: Original red, silver and dark detail reads on white. The original TONY’S AUTO SALES lettering and complete sports car remain.
surfaceReview.onDark: Solid white reads on #111113 and #101820. Original alpha and geometry remain; the car is a silhouette without its internal original color detail.
surfaceReview.onAccent: Solid white reads on #09090b, #17191c and #c40101 with the same silhouette limitation.
surfaceReview.compact: The complete source artwork is square-contained with its natural aspect ratio. The smallest icon sizes retain an identifiable logo shape, while full small-letter reading at 32 or 48 pixels is not claimed. No partial crop, initials or new mark was made.
